text.tspan: Death rate from indoor air pollution vs. per capita energy use 2023
Death rates from indoor air pollution are measured as the number of deaths per 100,000 individuals. Energy is
measured in kilowatt-hours of total energy supply per person.
Total energy supply (kilowatt-hours per person; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Death rate from indoor air pollution (deaths per 100,000 people)
